notes: Human (left) hand, entering from the upper left. Provenance: started from round-1 LEFT_HAND_SPEC in src/hand/skeleton.ts, re-read against aes-ref/alpha-white-geom.PNG on 4-8x zoomed crops (the step-2 start pose); calibrated in log-v2 step 2 (2026-09-21/22) and recalibrated on the step-3 builder (2026-09-23/24, D17/D18). Digit names follow user decision D2 (documentations/log/log-v2.md): THUMB = the digit with the large nail facing the viewer, coming diagonally out of the base of the palm (tip ~(562,458), D13); PINKY = the short leftmost digit curled under the palm, pointing back toward the wrist, tip ~(438,438); MIDDLE and RING = the two curled digits between, tips ~(601,523) and ~(532,505); INDEX = the extended digit reaching the contact point, tip (786,416). CALIBRATED: every joint px and r and the shape controls fitted to assets-source/reference/left-mask.png with a surrogate of build_hands.py's own SDF (minimum of the field along the camera ray through each pixel centre; Levenberg-Marquardt on the edge offset at every reference edge pixel, tighter at the fingertips, then a compass search on the count of edge px over 2 px) and checked with Blender builds, under anatomical constraints: every joint within 3x its keypoints.json uncertainty (D16); radii taper base->tip; 3D phalanx lengths near the 2026-09-22 pose's (+-8 %; middle/ring P1 free for D18); hinge anatomy: every finger's MCP a flexion of its metacarpal with |abduction| <= 12 deg, PIP and DIP bends in P1's hinge plane, the knuckles on a transverse line (11 deg off the lateral axis) spaced about the sum of their radii. Step-3 controls (D17): the index knuckle (head_back 0.77, knuckle_rise 0.27, phalanx_base 0.83); forearm sag on the dorsal and palmar lines; a dorsal wrist bump; a palm heel; the first dorsal interosseous; thenar 1.05; the hypothenar from 0.30 of the way to the little-finger knuckle; a thinner metacarpal base. D18 (see the step-2 run-7 report): the middle and ring fingers flex toward the palm at the MCP in their hinge planes (MCP flexion 31 / 47 deg); their PIPs lie 0.06 / 0.085 further from the camera than in the 2026-09-22 pose, and 3D P1/P2 is 1.20 / 1.36. The thumb's frame is rolled 95 deg from the dorsal (thumb_roll_deg; 72 before the dorsal turned) so the thumbnail keeps facing the viewer as drawn (D2), 2 deg from the camera direction. RECONSTRUCTED (not observable in one view): z depths (index and thumb toward the camera, ring and pinky away, consistent with the drawn overlaps), flat, and dorsal: with the knuckle row as drawn and hinged fingers the back of the hand faces up and about 17 deg away from the camera. The forearm px lies outside the frame so the arm leaves the frame.
